authors.description: authoring.authors -- Author and editor identities, one row per person.

posts.description: authoring.posts -- Authored content units moving through publication states.

columns.editor_id: Last editor; NULL for original author.
columns.title: Post headline.

comments.description: authoring.comments -- Reader comments, with replies linked to parent comments.

tags.description: taxonomy.tags -- Flat label vocabulary - one row per unique tag.

post_tags.description: taxonomy.post_tags -- Join rows assigning flat tags to posts.

categories.description: taxonomy.categories -- Two-level category taxonomy keyed by slug.

post_categories.description: taxonomy.post_categories -- Join rows assigning taxonomy categories to posts.

attachments.description: authoring.attachments -- Uploaded files attached to posts or left orphaned.

columns.post_id: FK -> posts.id; NULL for orphan uploads.

sync_markers.description: ops.sync_markers -- External sync cursors stored by namespace and key.

columns.namespace: Cursor group, e.g. feed or jobs.

event_log.description: ops.event_log -- Append-only analytics events, optionally tied to posts.

columns.post_id: FK -> posts.id; NULL for global events.
columns.payload: Opaque string or JSON by kind.

generated_metrics.description: unclustered.generated_metrics -- Synthetic metrics table demonstrating stored generated columns.

author_profiles.description: authoring.author_profiles -- View summarizing each author's total post count.
